documented_context: Flood warning for the Sumas River and Lower Fraser tributaries, including Chilliwack, Abbotsford and Hope.
Highway 1 closed between Sumas Way and No. 3 Road; evacuation orders covered 82 Huntingdon and 371 Sumas Prairie West properties, with 1,069 properties on alert.
Provincial update documented Highway 1 reopening work and remaining water on eastbound lanes in the wider affected region.
Event summary reported 485 properties under evacuation order, 1,069 on alert, property damage and livestock loss.
Wilson Road evacuation order described immediate danger from flooding due to the Chilliwack River.
